meta.title: Book a free AI audit
meta.description: Book a free 30-minute AI audit. Describe one slow, repetitive process and get a written, costed plan for automating it, whether or not you hire us.

hero.title: Book a free AI audit
hero.lede: Tell me about one slow, repetitive process. You get a 30-minute call and a written, costed plan for automating it. The plan is yours to keep, whether or not you hire us.

form.title: Send the details
form.intro: Five questions. I read every one myself and reply within one working day.

email.label: Work email
email.hint: The plan is sent here. No newsletter.

niche.label: What kind of business is it?

process.label: What is the slow, repetitive process?
process.hint: Two or three sentences is enough. Who does it, how often, and which tools it touches.

form.privacy: Your details are used to reply to this request and for nothing else.

errors.summary: Please fix the highlighted fields and send again.
errors.nameRequired: Enter your name so I know who to reply to.
errors.emailRequired: Enter your email address so I can send the plan.
errors.emailInvalid: That email address looks incomplete. It should look like name@company.com.
errors.nicheRequired: Choose the option closest to your business, or "Something else".
errors.processRequired: Describe the process you want to stop doing by hand.
errors.processShort: Add a little more detail: who does it, and roughly how often.

notConnected.title: This form is not connected yet
notConnected.text: Nothing was sent. Until the form is switched on, please email the same details instead. Your text is still in the form.
notConnected.ownerNote: TODO: paste your form endpoint into content/site.json as formEndpoint (a Formspree or Web3Forms URL), then rebuild.

failed.title: That did not send
failed.text: The request failed, possibly because of the connection. Your text is still in the form. Try again, or email the details instead.

success.title: Sent. Thank you.
success.text: I will reply within one working day with two or three times for the call. If you prefer to pick a time now, use the booking box on this page.

booking.title: Prefer to pick a time?
booking.text: Skip the form and book the 30-minute audit call directly. Times are shown in your own time zone.
booking.fallback: Open the booking page in a new tab
booking.consent: The calendar is provided by Calendly and loads only after you press the button.

placeholder.title: Booking calendar goes here
placeholder.text: TODO: paste your Calendly link into content/site.json as calendlyUrl, then rebuild. A button that loads the calendar will replace this box.

email.title: Or just write
email.text: A plain email works as well as the form.

steps.title: A short reply with two questions
steps.text: Within one working day I confirm the time and ask for anything missing, usually which tools you use and roughly how often the task happens.

steps.title: The 30-minute call
steps.text: You walk me through the process as it runs today, screen shared if you like. I ask where it breaks and what a mistake costs. No slides and no sales pitch.

steps.title: A written plan
steps.text: You get a one or two page plan: what to automate first, the setup fee and monthly cost, the expected return, and what could go wrong. If automating it will not pay, the plan says so.
steps.meta: TODO: confirm how many working days after the call

bring.title: What to bring to the call
items: One process, not five. The one that eats the most hours or loses the most enquiries
A rough count: how many times a week it happens and how long each one takes
The names of the tools involved, such as your CRM, phone system, booking software or spreadsheet
One real example, with customer details removed if needed
The person who does the task today, if that is not you
